mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, it is 88 degrees and partly cloudy at Fireman's Park. Tonight's Full Moon will be joined by a brief ISS flyover at 9:40 PM, moving from the West Southwest near Mount Horeb toward the Southwest. The overnight low will be 68 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The city has two major updates. First, the Senior Center is rolling out a Trishaw bike program, though participants must sign a legal waiver. Second, the City Clerk is holding a design contest for I Voted stickers, with student artwork being accepted until August 7.

Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking toward tomorrow, we have trivia nights at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company, while Wednesday brings the farmer's market to Hometown Junction Park and pizza deals at Lake Louie.
On July 26, officers responded to a hit-and-run crash near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane, which resulted in a citation for an 83-year-old Madison woman.
Culvers is serving up Snickers Swirl for their flavor of the day. They are open until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to grab a scoop before they close.
